objective: Improve native ContextBench Span-F1 through targeted within-file acquisition without file-quality regression or excessive total inference cost.
hypothesis: An interactive typed definition discovery tool lets the agent find relevant unread source inside already observed files more precisely than guessed line windows.
research_relation: Adaptation of structural class/method navigation, not an AutoCodeRover reproduction or transfer of its SWE-bench repair scores. No patching, SBFL or gold-derived search hints.

construction_boundary.authority: Standing owner private G01/G02/G03 benchmark and GLM approval; D65 candidate research only. No product admission, publication, activation, deployment or unopened confirmation exposure.
construction_boundary.product_frontier: Typed discovery metadata and unchanged ordinary read_file evidence acquisition.
construction_boundary.runnable_product_work: Source-capacity check, freeze complete12-case exposed development cohort, then run the new native navigation arm without altering archived controls or frozen failures.
construction_boundary.operational_lane: WSL source/parser/evidence, VPS-only GLM relay and credential. Parser subprocess denies socket/connect using Linux seccomp; cached grammar digests pinned.

construction_evidence.initial_failure: Only56/143 confirmed snapshots indexed, with23 subprocess failures,55 whole-file parse rejections and9 unsupported files. Preserved unchanged; not admitted for live generation.
construction_evidence.diagnosis: Repeated real-source processes crashed during garbage collection after producing JSON. Removing tree-sitter Point property reads and deriving exact inclusive line coordinates from byte offsets yielded30/30 successful processes. Similar upstream symptom is supporting context, not proof of identical root cause.
construction_evidence.capacity_claim_ceiling: Source/parser capacity only, not native acquisition or quality. The report's parsed bucket includes explicitly flagged partial indices.

source_policy.scope: Only exact pinned-base full-source snapshots associated with already executed ordinary reads/search; native source delivery remains separately verified. No global oracle index or new source-file suggestions.
source_policy.tool: find_definitions(path, query, kind, offset, limit): literal case-sensitive qualified-name substring, maximum10 results/page; empty query enumerates. Exact source/definition IDs, headers and coordinates are metadata only.
source_policy.acquisition: Model must issue normal read_file using base coordinates. Existing delivery binder, terminal handles and native export stay unchanged. No new read aliases, automatic span widening, final-output union or output repair.
source_policy.partial_parse: Expose only definitions whose own nodes have no parse errors, flag incomplete indices and rejected definition counts explicitly. Unsupported/invalid files remain in the full denominator and retain ordinary source tools.
source_policy.class_read_recommendation: At most10 lines, not entire class.
source_policy.function_read_recommendation: At most100 lines; longer definitions need ordinary pagination. No definition ID is a final context handle.

prospective_native_contract.cohort: All12 existing exposed cases, ascending original order; new arm in a new root, no retries or case replacements.
prospective_native_contract.label_barrier: Seal every attempted arm's source/output identity before native score evaluation. Full12 terminal campaign required for cohort quality interpretation. Stop provider uncertainty; retain attempted denominator and never replay it.
prospective_native_contract.control_posture: Previously sealed native control and historical DSH are development diagnostics, not new contemporaneous or untouched superiority comparators.
prospective_native_contract.claim_ceiling: Exposed native development qualification only. Broad superiority requires separately frozen fresh matched comparators, untouched confirmation, uncertainty analysis and exact reviewer-approved claim.

open_questions: Will typed navigation be used effectively rather than adding irrelevant reads and tokens?
Are partial C++ indices sufficiently useful while remaining explicit about unsupported macro constructs?
Does useful within-file coverage translate to native Span-F1 across the full12-case cohort?
Will any development gain survive equal-budget fresh matched comparators and untouched confirmation?
